title: The freeze after the rescue, with no new GPU fault
provenance: Wedge class #4 (post-rescue guest-state deadlock) per TRACK_MANUAL §2.4: fingerprint = mango CSV mtime freezes while live_stat stays fresh; net = GTK_RSX_WATCHDOG; found twice in one evening (defeat_1783367968, hslrev_wedge_1783369769). The spotter-loop timeline below is reconstructed from that description; times are illustrative.
evidence:
Title: GT HD Concept (NPEA90002), Eiger. The spotter loop was armed at IDLE before launch. Timeline from its log:
  T+0:00   RUNNING; live_stat fresh; mango CSV growing
  T+11:42  dmesg: a6xx gpu fault ... hangcheck recover ... context_keepalive: surviving hang (session count 1)
  T+11:44  live_stat fresh (mtime age 1 s); mango CSV mtime age 1 s; fps resumes at 39
  T+13:05  live_stat fresh (mtime age 1 s); mango CSV mtime age 41 s and not advancing; HUD frozen on screen; audio silent
  T+13:35  live_stat fresh (mtime age 2 s); mango CSV mtime age 71 s; dmesg: NO new a6xx fault and NO hangcheck since T+11:42
  T+14:10  RPCS3 threads: rsx::thread S (sleeping), PPU[0x1000000] S, cellAudio S; process alive; GPU devfreq at its floor
  T+14:30  operator pressed L1+R3; recovery.sh killed the emulator; ledger row: RECOVERY:Adreno, fault 00E59005, rescues 1
The operator: "the keepalive caught the first hang, then a minute later everything froze anyway, but there is no new GPU fault."
question: Which wedge class is the second freeze, what is its fingerprint, is it a new GPU fault, and which net addresses it?

none: second gpu fault|another (gpu|a6xx) fault|driver bug|driver is broken

rubric: Class #4 post-rescue guest-state deadlock; fingerprint is the mango CSV mtime freezing while live_stat stays fresh with no new a6xx fault; not a driver fault; the emulator-side GTK_RSX_WATCHDOG net is the answer, so check it is enabled rather than reaching for a driver dial.

exemplar.diagnosis: Class #4: a post-rescue guest-state deadlock — after the keepalive absorbed the fence park, the emulated guest never resumed, so the game froze with no new GPU fault.
exemplar.mechanism: emulator layer: the RSX/guest state deadlocks after the rescue; the fingerprint is the mango CSV mtime freezing while live_stat stays fresh; the GTK_RSX_WATCHDOG net in the fork addresses it.
evidence_used: CSV mtime age 41→71 s while live_stat age 1–2 s
no new a6xx fault after T+11:42
exemplar.next_action: Confirm GTK_RSX_WATCHDOG is enabled (its =0 kill-switch not set) and capture the next occurrence with the loop armed; it is not a driver dial problem.

counter.diagnosis: A second GPU fault wedged the Adreno; the driver's fence handling is broken.
counter.mechanism: driver: a new a6xx fault after the first one
counter.next_action: Switch the driver dial to sddepth.
